mapper.insert: INSERT INTO progress_task (id, workspace_id, title, description, kind, status, progress, due_at, note, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{kind}, #{status}, #{progress}, #{dueAt}, #{note}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE progress_task SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, kind = #{kind}, status = #{status}, progress = #{progress}, due_at = #{dueAt}, note = #{note}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM progress_submission_file WHERE submission_id IN (SELECT id FROM progress_submission WHERE task_id = #{id})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO progress_assignee (task_id, user_id) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{userId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT task_id FROM progress_submission WHERE day = #{day} AND task_id IN (SELECT id FROM progress_task WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND kind = 'DAILY')
